problem.title: Investing shouldn't be confusing
problem.subtitle: Investors without organization end up choosing between two extremes, and neither really solves the problem.

complex.title: Platforms that are too complex
complex.text: Hundreds of indicators, acronyms and charts that confuse anyone who just wants a clear view of where their money is.

sheets.title: Spreadsheets and notes
sheets.text: They are simple, but hard to maintain and deliver no useful visual conclusions about your portfolio.

learn.title: No safe place to learn
learn.text: There is hardly any simple way to simulate buys and sells to learn how the market works without risking real money.

solution.title: The middle ground that was missing
solution.subtitle: FinTracker is simple enough for any investor profile and complete enough to generate real insights about your portfolio.

points.overview: Consolidated portfolio view in a single screen
points.visual: Charts that show what matters, without visual clutter
points.practice: Virtual portfolios to practice before investing for real
